nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for access control, allowance checks and ownership assignment across ZillaInu.
address private owner; privileged address that gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spent/assigned in transferFrom and approve.
uint public totalSupply; set once in the constructor from _supply * 10**decimals.
mapping(address => uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-sender transfer counter incremented on every transferFrom.
mapping(address => bool) private canSale; whitelist bypass for the sale-condition check, set by _mints.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount configured by owner via init.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount configured by owner via init.
uint256 private _saleNum; per-address transfer cap configured by owner via init.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address set by the owner, bypasses the sale restriction in ensure.
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...488D (Uniswap V2 Router); also explicitly whitelisted in ensure.
transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; computes the Uniswap pair and enforces the sale-condition whitelist logic.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; spends allowance, checks ensure(), then mutates balanceOf with raw arithmetic.
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with an arbitrary caller value.
condition(address,uint) internal view; applies _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits and _onSaleNum counters.
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into any address with any calldata.
_mints(address,uint256) public; privileged balance overwrite and canSale whitelisting gated by owner or a hardcoded address.
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public; owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable; owner-only mass distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked.
setTradeAddress(address) public; owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress.
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; deterministic CREATE2 Uniswap pair address derivation.
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and max allowance to the Uniswap router.
a.delegatecall(b): fully attacker/owner-controlled delegatecall executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
uint total = _value * _tos.length: unchecked multiplication that can silently overflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked balance mutations without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked allowance decrement without SafeMath.
_to: destination address of transfer().
_value: amount transferred in transfer().
_from: source address checked against the whitelist in ensure().
_to: destination address checked against owner in ensure().
_value: amount passed to condition() from ensure().
_UNI: locally computed Uniswap pair address for this token and WETH.
_from: debited address in transferFrom().
_to: credited address in transferFrom().
_value: transferred/spent amount in transferFrom().
_spender: address receiving the allowance in approve().
_value: allowance amount written in approve().
_from: address whose _onSaleNum counter is compared to _saleNum in condition().
_value: amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
a: target address of the owner-only delegatecall.
b: arbitrary calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
spender: address whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted in _mints().
addedValue: raw token amount (in whole tokens) assigned to balanceOf[spender].
saleNum: value assigned to _saleNum in init().
token: whole-token minimum used to derive _minSale in init().
maxToken: whole-token maximum used to derive _maxSale in init().
_tos: recipient array iterated and length-multiplied in batchSend().
_value: per-recipient amount in batchSend().
total: _value * _tos.length, computed without overflow protection.
i: loop counter of the batchSend distribution loop.
_to: per-iteration recipient copied from _tos.
addr: new whitelisted trade address set by the owner.
factory: Uniswap factory address used in the CREATE2 pair derivation.
tokenA: first token of the pair.
tokenB: second token of the pair.
pair: derived pair address returned by pairFor().
token0: lexicographically lower of tokenA/tokenB.
token1: lexicographically higher of tokenA/tokenB.
_name: ERC20 name assigned in the constructor.
_symbol: ERC20 symbol assigned in the constructor.
_supply: whole-token supply scaled by 10**decimals to form totalSupply.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards the caller-controlled msg.sender as the _from address of transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and spends allowance[_from][msg.sender]; caller identity drives authorisation.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], using the caller as the allowance owner.
delegate() is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner); the whole privilege model rests on msg.sender.
_mints() gates balance overwrite on msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints totalSupply to the deployer.

transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor(...) to compute the Uniswap pool address _UNI.
ensure() reads owner for the whitelist short-circuit.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale restriction.
ensure() reads tradeAddress for the whitelist short-circuit.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
transferFrom() debits and credits balanceOf using raw += / -= arithmetic.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
approve() overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with the caller-supplied value (no zero-allowance guard).
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals instead of adding to it.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting unlimited transfer rights to an arbitrary address.
init() writes the derived _minSale limit.
init() writes the derived _maxSale limit.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend() subtracts total from and adds _value to balanceOf entries without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress() writes the whitelist bypass address tradeAddress (owner-only).
The constructor assigns owner from the deployer address.
The constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor approves uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router for the owner.
The constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall on attacker-supplied address and calldata, guarded only by an owner check.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without an overflow check.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf with unchecked subtraction/addition.
transferFrom() decrements the allowance mapping with unchecked arithmetic.
